risk_note: RV2 by path. Taobao promotion link wiring (D10-510, D10-503): POST /v1/shares converts through the union in its transaction and writes promo_url and share_materials, and a detail link gets the promotion link by an async job on queue pool-refresh, which keeps one handler dispatching by job name (a second registration stops the worker). convert.taobao_prefetch.enabled stays off until the owner changes TRADE-03 (D10-533). Both sit behind switches that default off (share.taobao_enabled, convert.taobao_prefetch.enabled, B1-06ze), so merged behaviour stays 50301 not_launched and frozen [AC-B1-15w#3] holds. A share without a link or a token generates nothing (BR-ATTR-10). The job uses only the snapshot identity and checks the current active relation_id; promo_url is written once with WHERE promo_url IS NULL and row_version untouched; the open flow calls no union. Turning share.taobao_enabled on needs the real test order of D10-503. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
